chapters.title: We bring back trust to hiring
avatars and not the real people
verification moves from the end of the process to the beginning
Skill match plus trust score becomes the combined filter
Two-sided verification. Candidates and companies both get checked
from six weeks with six eight candidates down to two weeks and three
Verified trust becomes the default before any screening call
